'''Incomplete article.''' The Japanese card face is shown. Fields awaiting verification are marked below.

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ウーティーニー！</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-276o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：自分のジャワの１人がウーティーニー・エフェクトと同じ場所にいるなら、そのウーティーニー・エフェクトを“盗んで”自分の手札にいれることができる。盗んだ後は、自分のカードとして使用できる。２：カードの名前に“ジャワ”が含まれるインタラプトかエフェクトを１つ打ち消すことができる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">Ｒ２－Ｄ２をイオン化銃で撃ったジャワは、仲間に向かって「ウーティーニー！」と叫んだ。ジャワの言葉で「ここに来い！」という意味だ。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Utinni!

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. If one of your Jawas is at the same location as an Utinni Effect, you may steal it into your hand and use it as your own card. 2. You may cancel one Interrupt or Effect with Jawa in its title.

'''Lore:''' The Jawa who shot R2-D2 with an ion gun called “Utinni!” to the others. In Jawaese, it means “Come here!”

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 4

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
